title: Corporate Wellness | Gainesville Health & Fitness
description: Bring GHF to your team. Corporate memberships, on-site wellness, and healthier, happier, more productive employees across Gainesville.

blocks.sub: Corporate memberships and on-site wellness that make your people feel their best — and bring that energy back to work.

blocks.title: Well people do *better* work
paragraphs: Teams that move together are healthier, more energized, and more connected. A GHF corporate membership gives your employees the guidance, variety and community that actually keeps them coming back.
From 24/7 strength floors to 900+ monthly classes, hot yoga, Pilates, recovery and our aqua center — there's something for every fitness level on your team.
blocks.alt: A GHF personal trainer coaching a client

blocks.title: We bring wellness *to you*
paragraphs: Prefer to start at the office? Our team can run on-site fitness demos, lunch-and-learns and challenge programs to kick things off — then transition your team into full club access.
Flexible corporate rates, simple billing, and a dedicated GHF contact to keep it all running smoothly.
blocks.alt: A coached group training session at GHF

blocks.title: Let's build your *team's* plan
blocks.text: Tell us about your company and we'll put together corporate rates and a wellness plan that fits. No charge, no obligation.
